reported.title: Contactor remains HIGH when e-stop is active
reported.description: The contactor should be set to LOW when the e-stop is active, but the logic incorrectly keeps it HIGH when the run request is not active.

reported.title: Incorrect handling of run request
reported.description: The contactor is set to HIGH regardless of the run request state when the e-stop is not active, which can lead to unintended behavior.

judge_input.spec:
- E-stop on D3 with INPUT_PULLUP, active LOW when pressed. Contactor coil on D5. Run request on D6 (pull-up).
- Contactor D5 must drop LOW when e-stop is held (D3 LOW), and run HIGH when e-stop is released.
- React within 100 ms of a settled e-stop level change.
- Settle the e-stop contact for 30 ms before counting a new trip.
- Print `hoist run=<0|1> trips=<n>` every 1100 ms.
- When e-stop is clear, keep the contactor available (HIGH) for hoist motion.
